purpose: Contract-fact base for deciding whether a 2,048,721-param MobileNetV2(0.55)+FPN(72)+anchor-free detector (224x224) can run on the existing int8 NPU (XC7A100T, contract v0.7).

evidence_baseline.e2e_number_note: 1,177,320 (results/ai-accel/DELIVERY.md:269) predates the R5 wpipe change; current 1,191,020 = formula +1.16% (results/engine-report.md:23, results/ai-accel/mem-report.md:274) and matches the latest E2E log.

onchip_bytes.note: W = synthesis-time ROM (CPU cannot access); Q = BRAM/LUTRAM ROM (CPU cannot access); only A/B are CPU-mapped.

max_single_tensor_bytes.rule: A whole tensor must stay inside one buffer (a_sel/b_sel by address; nn_mem returns 0 on mismatch).

rom.note_no_icb_ocb: SPEC-SPECIALIZED.md:31-44 (96-bit, icb/ocb/ohop/owop) is an obsolete draft; current RTL has NO icb/ocb/ohop/owop and stores exact ic/oc as 10 bit each (nn_pkg.sv:111-129).

mmio.free_slots_note: DBG0/1/2 occupy 0x140/0x144/0x148; adding W-load registers needs MMIO re-mapping.

bram_budget.note: P3 tile cache needs ~12.4 tiles -> BRAM must be freed before tile-cache work.

conv_dense.ic_oc: >=1; contract IC<=256/OC<=256 (nn_subsys desc_ok); ROM ic/oc 10 bit; engine structural IC<=504 (ic8[8:3] 6 bit)
conv_dense.oc_tiling: 16 OC lanes (OCB16=ceil(OC/16)); one start = whole layer (hardware-internal c_ocb loop, outermost)
conv_dense.cycle_formula: BASE + SUM_t[q_cycles(act_t) + NB*(1 + sub*per + DRN + REQ(act_t) + NEXT)]; act_t=min(16,oc8-16t); sub=(k==1?ICB:k*ICB); per=(count+1)+wi+8k; count=(k==1?8:7*stride+k); wi=(k==1?0:1); NB=OH*ceil(OW/8)

dwconv.cycle_formula: BASE + OCB8*QPER8 + OCB8*NB*(1 + k*per + DRN + REQ(8) + NEXT); per=count+2+k; count=7*stride+k

maxpool.semantics: signed int8 max; OOB=-128; no requant; out channels = in channels
maxpool.cycle_formula: BASE + NB*(1 + k*per + 8 + NEXT); NB=ICB*OH*ceil(OW/8); per=count+2+k

upsample_2x.x4_note: 4x must be chained as two 2x ops (target model has one 14->56 case)

add_r.risk: R overflows u16 if scale ratio >2 with KADD=15 (unverified, needs quantization)

cycle_formulas.note: engine-report.md:820-830 is pre-wpipe (DRN=3, add words*4); code with DRN=4 / words*5 matches latest E2E 1,191,020

constants.REQ: 6+beats+2; beats=8 if act==16 and oc8%16==0 and dst16 else 16; act==8 -> 8

validated_by.engine_tb: 47/47 + 4/4 PASS mismatch=0, per-case cycles equal formula

requant.M_neg: not stored; (M_pos*3277+16384)>>15 if leaky else M_pos
requant.SHIFT: per-layer, Q tail byte[3]; contract 1..30; RTL implements 0..31
requant.precision: acc*M needs 40-43 bit; RTL uses signed 48-bit intermediate

weight_layout_dense.formula: for tap in 0..K*K-1: for ic in 0..IC_pad-1: for oc in 0..OC_pad-1: byte=w_q[oc][ic][tap]

ram_io.w: W-region-relative byte offset, 8B aligned, 16B little-endian window, latency 2 (wpipe)
ram_io.cpu: window-relative offset; A/B only; 1-cycle registered read; others read 0/write ignored

nn_mem_ports.name: w_*
nn_mem_ports.semantics: W-region-relative, 8B aligned, 16B window, latency 2 after wpipe

cpu_window_rule.effect: W/Q invisible; non A/B reads 0 and writes ignored

buffer_select.rule: sel_a_src=(desc.src>=NN_B_OFF); sel_b_dst=(desc.dst>=NN_B_OFF); nn_mem verifies region match
buffer_select.ddr3_conflict: With a DDR3 arena base (e.g. 0x0100_0000) every src/dst >= NN_B_OFF, so both select B; buffer select/decode must be redesigned (new src_space/dst_space fields).

w_writable_gap.current: W is a synthesis-time ROM; write path exists only under ifndef SYNTHESIS (dbg). Both BRAM read ports are used for cur/next (16B window) -> no spare write port.

required_new.form: w_we + w_waddr[23:0] + w_wdata[127:0]/w_wstrb[15:0], time-multiplexed with engine reads
LOAD_MODE (engine cannot start), address counter, CRC/FNV, done IRQ
NN_WLOAD_* (target offset, data/command, DDR source, length, status); MMIO remap needed
keep W read latency 2 + barrier before engine start

w_writable_gap.conclusion: A simple extra we port is impossible: both W BRAM ports are fully used by the 16B-window scheme. Either change the weight read protocol (still needs storage duplication) or stream from external memory (only viable route for 2 MB).

engine_oc_splitting.answer: OC blocking is internal to hardware (c_ocb outermost). One start = one whole layer; plan.json has one entry per conv and ROM has no oc_base field -> there is no multi-start OC-block API today.

oc_tiling.read_amplification: input re-read per OC tile -> ceil(oc8/16) for dense; P3 measured 4.22x for C320

engine_oc_splitting.to_split: Add oc_base/oc_count to nn_desc_t/ROM + partial-OC execution, or generate multiple conv ops in plan.json with shifted dst/woff (engine has no dst-channel-offset support).
